1.web: The third day, there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.
1.asv: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:

2.web: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the marriage.
2.asv: and Jesus also was bidden, and his disciples, to the marriage.

3.web: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”
3.asv: And when the wine failed, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.

4.web: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”
4.asv: And Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.

5.web: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”
5.asv: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.

6.web: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.
6.asv: Now there were six waterpots of stone set there after the Jews’ manner of purifying, containing two or three firkins apiece.

7.web: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” They filled them up to the brim.
7.asv: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.

8.web: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.
8.asv: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the ruler of the feast. And they bare it.

9.web: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom,
9.asv: And when the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and knew not whence it was (but the servants that had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast calleth the bridegroom,

10.web: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”
10.asv: and saith unto him, Every man setteth on first the good wine; and when men have drunk freely, then that which is worse: thou hast kept the good wine until now.

11.web: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
11.asv: This beginning of his signs did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

12.web: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.
12.asv: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, andhisbrethren, and his disciples; and there they abode not many days.

13.web: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
13.asv: And the passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

14.web: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.
14.asv: And he found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:

15.web: He made a whip of cords, and threw all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew their tables.
15.asv: and he made a scourge of cords, and cast all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew their tables;

16.web: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”
16.asv: and to them that sold the doves he said, Take these things hence; make not my Father’s house a house of merchandise.

17.web: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”
17.asv: His disciples remembered that it was written, Zeal for thy house shall eat me up.

18.web: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”
18.asv: The Jews therefore answered and said unto him, What sign showest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?

19.web: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”
19.asv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

20.web: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”
20.asv: The Jews therefore said, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou raise it up in three days?

21.web: But he spoke of the temple of his body.
21.asv: But he spake of the temple of his body.

22.web: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.
22.asv: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he spake this; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.

23.web: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.
23.asv: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, during the feast, many believed on his name, beholding his signs which he did.

24.web: But Jesus didn’t trust himself to them, because he knew everyone,
24.asv: But Jesus did not trust himself unto them, for that he knew all men,

25.web: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.
25.asv: and because he needed not that any one should bear witness concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.
